data.title: Housing Application Deadline – Musterfield Exchange Programme
data.summary: The Musterfield Exchange Programme's International Admissions office confirms Daniel O'Connor's place in the exchange programme and states that the completed housing application form is due by 03/06/2026, with late forms placed on a waiting list.
data.explanation: This is a welcome letter for your exchange programme place. It asks you to submit the housing application form by the stated deadline; if you send it later, you will not be guaranteed housing right away and will instead be placed on a waiting list. Make sure to complete and return the housing form before the date printed in the letter to secure your preferred housing option.
